progression.narrative: The performance opens on A3 and dwells most on A in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (1:00.7) introduces Bk, centred on A. Phrase 7 (2:29.7) introduces Eb, centred on D. Phrase 12 (4:32.5) introduces D, Fk, Fs, centred on G. The line peaks at C5 (494.5 Hz) at 2:19.5. It closes on the tonic (G4 → Eb4 → Eb4 → C4 → Bk3 → A4).
